segments.name: Novel biologics
segments.description: Developing clinical and preclinical novel biologics, including bempikibart, for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases such as alopecia areata.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment, focused on research, development, and discovering, developing and delivering therapies for its novel biologics.
